$comment: Diastole avatar parts. Data, not code: add or replace options here (or swap in an illustrator's SVG) without touching the renderer. Canvas is 200x320, front-facing, centered at x=100. Tokens: {skin} {skinShade} {hair} {hairShade} {outfit} {outfitShade} {accent} {id}. Body silhouettes define clip regions #{id}-torso, #{id}-arms, #{id}-legs that outfits draw into, so every outfit fits every body and slider setting. 'unlock' names an achievement key (see lib/avatar/unlocks.ts); locked parts show what earns them.
